La finale de la deuxième édition du Top: The final of the second Top Modèle Baruck Guinée edition took place on Saturday 8 August 2026 at Kofi Annan University in Guinea, starting at 7 pm.
L’édition a réuni des candidats venus de: The edition brought together contestants from several countries in the subregion. On the catwalk, each presented an appearance to the audience, in traditional clothing and contemporary creations.
La soirée s’est achevée par la remise de: The evening ended with the awards: winners received their Top Modèle Baruck Guinée 2026 sashes and gifts on stage.
Parrain de l’événement : le PDG du Group: Event patron: the CEO of Groupe Baruck.
En amont de la finale, il avait reçu la: Before the final, he received Radiodiffusion Télévision Guinéenne (RTG), the national television broadcaster, at Baruck Communication headquarters in Conakry to present the Group’s areas of activity and preparations for the competition.
Dans une vidéo publiée sur la page Faceb: In a video published on the Group’s Facebook page, the CEO discussed the purpose of the event. Baruck is not a modelling agency: it is a communications company, and the competition was not organised to compete with agencies.
Pour lui, le mannequinat est un métier n: For him, modelling is a noble profession: models showcase brands and help people understand new collections. The competitions therefore honour models and help them earn a living from their profession.
Les dotations vont dans ce sens : 20 mil: The prizes reflect this purpose: 20 million Guinean francs to be shared for the first edition, Miss Baruck Guinée in 2025, followed by 80 million Guinean francs for this second edition.
Cette deuxième édition est la dernière d: This second edition is the last of its kind. Future events will take the form of fashion shows linked to the clothing company the Group is preparing to open, where models will showcase its collections.
Les tenues seront commandées auprès de s: Outfits will be commissioned from fashion designers, with each model presenting one designer’s work. Former models will also be honoured for introducing the profession to the generations that followed.
